description: Read the model id and vector dimension of the provider bound to embedding_service, without embedding any text. Cheap and read-only; both values come from the provider itself. Pass model to ask whether a specific model is the bound one; a model the provider does not serve is refused with an unsupported_model error.
embedding_description: Which embedding model does the solet use? Answers with the model id and vector size, the number of dimensions, of the bound service; the caller supplies no text and receives no vectors. Read-only compatibility check against a stored vector index or schema column width.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: data.result holds dimension (the provider's vector length) and model (the provider's model id); action_status, data, actions, error and timestamp are always present
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: State the model id and dimension together.
result_processor_customizations.output_action_guidance: Determine the appropriate next action based on the context and action result.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Retrieves the vector dimension (number of floats) for an embedding model. Dimension is needed for vector database schema configuration.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: error.code is the provider's own code. unsupported_model: model is not the bound provider's model. unavailable: the provider is not ready.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: Omit model to read the bound provider's own. For unavailable, read the provider's readiness error.
